purpose: Give a reason or mark a starting point.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
give explain a reason cause result
Clause + から for a reason; noun + から for a starting point.
I will take an umbrella because it is raining.
I will walk from the station.
The shop is open from nine.
Present a reason as an assertion or background
formation: Clause + から for a reason; noun + から for a starting point.
restrictions: Noun and な-adjective reasons use だから in plain style.
mistake: Distinguish a reason clause from the noun marking a starting point.
